_comment: Models are the primary entity: configure one, then list the lanes it covers.
Two models on the same lane is the point, not a mistake — lanes buy coverage,
doubling up within a lane buys depth.
Any lane (correctness, security, contract, ux, gate) with no model
assigned is reported as NOT SWEPT and makes the run exit non-zero. It is never
silently omitted, because a missing lane reads exactly like a clean one.
Model ids are 'vendor:model'. A bare name means Claude. An empty model after
the colon means that CLI's own default. Supported vendors are claude, codex,
cursor, and opencode. The Cursor binary on PATH is 'agent'. kilo: and kimi:
are refused.
This file is the Balanced preset: one Claude model on every lane, which is
enough for a first run when the claude CLI is installed and signed in.
Add another object for a second vendor, for example
{ "id": "codex:", "lanes": ["correctness", "security"] } or
{ "id": "opencode:ollama/qwen3:8b", "lanes": ["correctness"] }.
Remove any row whose CLI is not installed. A row that cannot run is
NOT SWEPT and the command exits non-zero, even when another model covered
the same lane.
Set use_agents to true on a Claude or Codex model to ask it to delegate
independent lane work in parallel. Claude uses two foreground Ultracode agents;
Codex chooses its fan-out. Cursor and OpenCode cannot delegate.
